title: Bound the shifted compatible feature by four affine means
statement: For every real A and periodic compatible W1,4 G, let R be the counterclockwise quarter turn and W(F)=F1+R F2. Then integral|W(A+G)|^4-|W(A)|^4 >=(3/80)integral|G|^4. With W(A)=0 the coefficient improves to1/25. On the original complex compatible graph G1=p+h,G2=i(p-h),p=B h,mean p=h=0,integral|p|^2=integral|h|^2,W(G)=2h,put W(A)=2q0,D=integral|q0+h|^4-|q0|^4,C=integral|h|^4,P=integral|p|^4,a0=|q0|^2integral|h|^2,b0=integral Re(conj(q0)h)^2. Supplied Burkholder density (3|q|-|p|)(|p|+|q|)^3 is quasiconvex at EVERY affine mean;normalize by27/16 to U. Exact majorant81|q|^4-|p|^4-U=(|p|-3|q|)^2(11|p|^2+66|p||q|+135|q|^2)/16>=0. Apply at FOUR actual affine means p0=3q0,3iq0,-3q0,-3iq0 using SAME potential. Exact four-point average gives P+36a0<=81D. Expansion gives D>=(sqrt(C)-2sqrt(b0))^2+2a0,a0>=b0. Combine with nine copies of that bound to obtain P+9(sqrt(C)-2sqrt(b0))^2+54b0<=90D;weighted Cauchy-Schwarz yields(sqrt(P)+sqrt(C))^2<=320D/3. Thus integral|G|^4<=1280D/3 and Delta|W|^4=16D. No sign assumption on sqrt(C)-2sqrt(b0). At q0=0,P<=81C gives1/25;source reports a paid compact radial Lipschitz sharpness construction for THIS unshifted constant,not optimality of3/80. Smooth approximation/fourth growth pays W1,4 extension. No amplitude/frequency/concentration/output-direction cap or new operator oracle.
